subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: infamous status
fact: The group is already infamous underground, with their name on posters in Gracklstugh.
source_quote: We're already infamous underground. It didn't seem to serve us well.

subject: Candlekeep naming ceremony
fact: A naming ceremony for the new head of Candlekeep is scheduled for tomorrow morning.
source_quote: Tomorrow morning's naming ceremony clearly will not name her.

subject: Zone of Truth spell mechanics
fact: The Zone of Truth spell does not force truth, but reveals if someone can resist it.
source_quote: The spell doesn't hand you the truth. It hands you the ability to watch someone refuse it.

subject: Bookwyrm's potential decline
fact: Bookwyrm may be offered the opportunity to decline submission to a Zone of Truth, which would imply guilt.
source_quote: We will give her the opportunity to decline. Her declining will further weaken her support among the other Avowed.

subject: academic paper on truth sources
fact: An academic paper argues that one source of truth is insufficient; three different kinds are required.
source_quote: My paper says you can't rely on one source of truth; you need three different kinds.

subject: magic book to prove culpability
fact: A magical book exists in Candlekeep’s library that could prove Bookwyrm’s culpability after the fact.
source_quote: I will come up with such a book before you leave.

subject: Alkrist's confession
fact: Alkrist confessed to killing Janussi under the influence of a spell that kept him honest.
source_quote: Alkrist had said it out loud, in the room, with Kalan's spell still holding him honest — he'd killed Janussi.

subject: Gracklstugh posters
fact: Posters in Gracklstugh bear the group's name, wrongly attributed but still recognizable.
source_quote: Gracklstugh still had our name on posters, wrong enough to be cover but our name all the same.

subject: Ember Vanguard legend
fact: The Ember Vanguard is a larger, more feared legend that precedes the group in every rumor.
source_quote: The Ember Vanguard has a legend now that walks a tunnel ahead of us, and it lies about our height.

subject: cleaver and heart as evidence
fact: A cleaver and a heart are physical evidence tied to the crime, but do not identify the perpetrator.
source_quote: You have a confession, a heart, and a cleaver.

subject: Dawnbringer's psychic connection
fact: Dawnbringer communicates mentally, with a sound like a palm slapping stone, indicating a psychic link.
source_quote: a click inside my skull, a sound like a palm slapping stone

subject: Candlekeep Avowed hierarchy
fact: The Avowed of Candlekeep are subject to internal politics, with leadership changing via vote.
source_quote: The new head may give Bookwyrm one of two choices: continue as a member of the Avowed, or submit to a Zone of Truth.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch's cowardice
fact: Kalan avoids direct confrontation with Bookwyrm out of fear she may become his superior.
source_quote: He's not going to do it without her permission — how about I put it that way?

subject: Fembris Lancer as potential successor
fact: Fembris Lancer is likely to be elected as the new head of the Avowed after Bookwyrm's downfall.
source_quote: Fembris Lancer will probably get elected the new avowed

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: one more thing
fact: One more thing is the final twist in the scheme, revealed after the audience believes the conflict is resolved.
source_quote: one more thing

subject: potion of flying
fact: The potion of flying was stolen from the safe by Glabbagool's arm while everyone was distracted.
source_quote: my Glabbagool arm swipes the potion of flying

subject: red herring coin
fact: One gold coin in the safe bore a red herring stamp, a deliberate red herring.
source_quote: one of the gold coins had a herring stamped on it, and the herring was red

subject: Deneir's Sanctum
fact: The adventurers were escorted to Deneir's Sanctum to wait under guard, treated as protected witnesses.
source_quote: I will ask Kalan Strongbranch to escort you to Deneir's Sanctum

subject: taster for food
fact: Fembris Lancer was unofficially appointed as the food taster, accepting the risk without suspicion.
source_quote: I'd say 118

subject: sapphire detection
fact: A Locate Object spell was cast to detect a sapphire on Bookwyrm; none was found.
source_quote: I'm hoping she has one on her — that would be interesting

subject: safe sealed and ignored
fact: The safe was closed and declared of no interest, despite containing the potion of flying and the red herring coin.
source_quote: They closed the safe with everything still inside... and declared it of no interest

subject: cure for Daral
fact: The party deliberated whether to cure Daral of his condition, leaving the decision unresolved.
source_quote: Should we cure him?

subject: Bookwyrm's relief
fact: Bookwyrm was genuinely relieved that the investigation had concluded and the adventurers were removed from play.
source_quote: she was delighted to have us wrapped up and out of everything

subject: Glabbagool's satisfaction
fact: Glabbagool expressed approval of the flying skill acquired from the potion, calling it a good skill.
source_quote: I like the flying skill. That was a good skill.

subject: Deneir's Sanctum as cell
fact: Deneir's Sanctum, normally a place of scholarship, was repurposed as a guarded waiting room.
source_quote: a room built for people who read for a living, now doing duty as a cell

subject: Kalan's resurgence
fact: Kalan Strongbranch resumed his position of authority after the investigation, believing his methods had been vindicated.
source_quote: how our actions had proven the value of his methods

subject: healing potion
fact: A potion of superior healing remained in the sealed safe, unclaimed.
source_quote: A potion of superior healing

subject: purse of gold coins
fact: A fat purse of gold coins, more than a man keeps for honest reasons, was found in the safe.
source_quote: A fat purse of gold coins, more than a man keeps for honest reasons

subject: Ambush of the Helmed Horrors
fact: Glass and wood came in at the same time, from three directions, and for a breath none of us had moved.
source_quote: Glass and wood came in at the same time, from three directions, and for a breath none of us had moved.

subject: helmed horror count
fact: Three suits of plate with nobody inside, walking and hovering, lifting a hand's width off the floor and drifting.
source_quote: Three suits of plate with nobody inside, walking and — this was the part that made my neck itch — hovering, lifting a hand's width off the floor and drifting.

subject: Deneir's office
fact: We sat in Deneir's office, fed by proxy, our patient healed, wondering how the story was going to end.
source_quote: We sat in Deneir's office, fed by proxy, our patient healed, wondering how the story was going to end.

subject: Dawnbringer's sentience
fact: Dawnbringer was drinking it in. A sword that spends its days pointed at fungus and undead, being told at length that it is beautiful, that it is worthy of study.
source_quote: Dawnbringer was drinking it in. A sword that spends its days pointed at fungus and undead, being told at length that it is beautiful, that it is worthy of study.

subject: Daz's revelation
fact: The key in his pocket was dead, inert — and three suits of murderous plate had come through the windows to die for it.
source_quote: The key in his pocket was dead, inert — and three suits of murderous plate had come through the windows to die for it.

subject: key's detection property
fact: The key itself, sniffing it out through plate and pocket both, was the only thing the helmed horrors followed.
source_quote: The key itself, sniffing it out through plate and pocket both, was the only thing the helmed horrors followed.

subject: Dawnbringer's activation
fact: The blade lit, poured into Daral, and took the sickness with it. He straightened. He breathed. In the space of a heartbeat he was a well man, and he was ecstatic.
source_quote: The blade lit, poured into Daral, and took the sickness with it. He straightened. He breathed. In the space of a heartbeat he was a well man, and he was ecstatic.

subject: Combat resolution
fact: The last of them folded down into piles of rust and loose plate, like they'd never been anything but junk somebody stacked up.
source_quote: The last of them folded down into piles of rust and loose plate, like they'd never been anything but junk somebody stacked up.

subject: Deneir's office
fact: The story answered. 'Combat?' Zalthir said. Yes. Combat.
source_quote: The story answered. 'Combat?' Zalthir said. Yes. Combat.

subject: Dawnbringer as divining rod
fact: Can we grab one of them and use it to detect who else has the key? Turn it into a sort of divining rod, as it were.
source_quote: Can we grab one of them and use it to detect who else has the key? Turn it into a sort of divining rod, as it were.
